title: /l/:code signed in — claim a guest history

chrome.crumb: Kyiv Debate Club › Your guest history

lines: This personal link belongs to Olena, a guest at Thursday practice in Kyiv Debate Club.
If that guest was you, add their results to your account. They show on My page under your name, and this link stops working.

blocks.text: Claiming uses the engine's own one-time claim token (POST users/claim-participant/:pid), presented as the account; the place takes the account's name and a won night is credited to it. The guest's cab account and link are deleted. Another guest identity cannot claim.
